components.name: Chart/Slope
components.description: Change between exactly two points (before/after, last year/this year) for 3–10 items. Default colours by direction (dataviz/positive / negative); Highlight shows one item in a series colour and mutes the rest (layer opacity 45%, BND-09). Labels at both ends replace the axis. React: <SlopeChart data={[{ label, from, to }]} highlight? />
